name: superpowers
description: An agentic skills framework & software development methodology that works.
one_liner: A structured playbook that makes AI coding assistants stop and plan properly before writing code, instead of jumping straight into messy, over-engineered solutions.
buyer: A startup engineering lead whose team's AI-assisted code is getting sloppy and hard to maintain, and wants a proven process to enforce discipline.
business_use_cases: An engineering lead installs it across the team's coding agents to enforce spec-first planning and real test-driven development before any code ships.
A solo indie developer uses it to keep a single AI coding agent from over-engineering a side project into something unmaintainable.
A dev-tools consultant runs paid 'AI coding agent onboarding' workshops for engineering teams, using this framework as the curriculum.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid workshops teaching engineering teams how to set up and enforce this methodology across their AI coding agents.
Provide ongoing consulting support for teams customizing the skill set to their own codebase conventions.

steal_this: Run a free one-hour workshop for a local dev meetup showing how to wire this into Claude Code, then offer paid follow-up sessions to teams who want it rolled out company-wide.
